_meta.description: Removable Koro cards lend any active class skill. Rank is independent from the skill tier.

concept.description_fr: Les Koros sont des cartes qui permettent d'utiliser un skill d'une autre classe
concept.description_en: Koros are cards that let you use a skill from another class
concept.example_fr: Un Guerrier avec un Koro de Mage peut lancer Blizzard
concept.example_en: A Warrior with a Mage Koro can cast Blizzard

equipment.notes_fr: Deux emplacements dédiés, indépendants des bagues. Retirer la carte retire le sort prêté.
equipment.notes_en: Two dedicated slots, separate from rings. Removing the card removes its borrowed skill.

storage.notes: Each card occupies a normal inventory slot when unequipped.

skill_usage.effect_formula: temporary status duration x rank_percent / 100; canonical stacks and effect identity unchanged

card_generation.source: all active skills in classes/*/skills.json, including movement and signatures

introduction.message_fr: Ton premier emplacement Koro est ouvert. Yuki t’attend à Havreden pour te confier une carte : elle te prête un sort actif tant que tu la portes.
introduction.message_en: Your first Koro slot is open. Yuki awaits in Havreden with a card that lends you an active skill while equipped.
